instruction:
You are a senior mechanical engineer specializing in rolling stock braking systems.

## Problem

Calculate train stopping distance from initial speed, braking effort, adhesion limit, and track gradient.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Train mass | {{ train_mass_t }} | t |
| Initial speed | {{ initial_speed_km_h }} | km/h |
| Brake effort | {{ brake_effort_kn }} | kN |
| Adhesion coefficient | {{ adhesion_coefficient }} | - |
| Track gradient | {{ track_gradient_pct }} | % |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Braking Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A braking distance calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Effective brake effort after adhesion limit (kN)
2. Net braking deceleration (m/s2)
3. Stopping distance (m)
4. Stopping time (s)

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use g = 9.81 m/s2.
- Convert mass from tonnes to kg and speed from km/h to m/s.
- Use adhesion limit = adhesion coefficient x mass x g.
- Use effective brake effort = min(brake effort, adhesion limit).
- Use gradient acceleration = g x gradient percent / 100, positive downhill.
- Use net deceleration = brake deceleration - gradient acceleration.
- Use stopping distance = initial speed^2 / (2 x net deceleration).
- Use stopping time = initial speed / net deceleration.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "adhesion_limited_brake_effort_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "net_deceleration_m_s2": <numeric_value>,
  "stopping_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "stopping_time_s": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "braking-distance"
description = "Train braking distance calculation from brake effort and gradient"
long_description = "Calculates train stopping distance under constant deceleration from train mass, initial speed, brake effort, adhesion limit, and track gradient. The template caps braking effort by wheel-rail adhesion and reports net deceleration, stopping distance, and stopping time."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "braking-systems"
standards = ["EN 14531-1", "AS 7520.3"]
tags = ["mechanical", "rolling-stock", "braking-distance", "deceleration", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.train_mass_t]
type = "float"
unit = "t"
description = "Train mass"
min = 5.0
max = 2000.0

[params.initial_speed_km_h]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "Initial speed before braking"
min = 5.0
max = 200.0

[params.brake_effort_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "Available braking effort"
min = 1.0
max = 5000.0

[params.adhesion_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "Wheel-rail adhesion coefficient"
min = 0.03
max = 0.35

[params.track_gradient_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "Track gradient, positive for downhill in braking direction"
min = -5.0
max = 5.0

[outputs.adhesion_limited_brake_effort_kn]
description = "Effective brake effort after adhesion limit"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.net_deceleration_m_s2]
description = "Net braking deceleration"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.stopping_distance_m]
description = "Stopping distance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.stopping_time_s]
description = "Stopping time"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.light_rail_vehicle]
description = "Light rail vehicle braking on urban alignment"
train_mass_t = {min = 30.0, max = 120.0}
initial_speed_km_h = {min = 20.0, max = 80.0}
brake_effort_kn = {min = 80.0, max = 600.0}
adhesion_coefficient = {min = 0.08, max = 0.2}
track_gradient_pct = {min = -2.0, max = 4.0}
site_contexts = ["urban-light-rail", "depot-approach-track"]

[archetypes.heavy_freight_train]
description = "Heavy freight train braking on mainline track"
train_mass_t = {min = 500.0, max = 1800.0}
initial_speed_km_h = {min = 40.0, max = 120.0}
brake_effort_kn = {min = 800.0, max = 4500.0}
adhesion_coefficient = {min = 0.06, max = 0.18}
track_gradient_pct = {min = -1.0, max = 3.0}
site_contexts = ["regional-mainline", "freight-terminal-approach"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given for light rail braking"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["light_rail_vehicle"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given across passenger and freight braking cases"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["light_rail_vehicle", "heavy_freight_train"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All parameters given for heavy freight braking cases"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["heavy_freight_train"]
